title: Carlos Alcaraz withdraws from Cincinnati Open due to wrist injury
summary: Tennis player Carlos Alcaraz has withdrawn from the Cincinnati Open due to a wrist injury. Alcaraz, the defending champion of the ATP Masters 1000 event, was expected to compete. His withdrawal raises doubts about his participation in the upcoming US Open, where he is also the defending champion.
summary_points: Carlos Alcaraz withdrew from the Cincinnati Open.
The reason for his withdrawal is a wrist injury.
Alcaraz is the defending champion of the Cincinnati Open.
His withdrawal casts doubt on his participation in the US Open.
Alcaraz is also the defending champion of the US Open.
